## Change

Describe the resulting behavior and affected systems.

## Save compatibility

State the save impact, including “none” for changes that do not affect saved data or progression. Identify affected serialized layouts, persistent IDs or initialization and any migration. Follow [the save-compatibility requirement](../docs/SAVE-COMPATIBILITY.md); record the old formats and load → save → reload evidence when applicable.

## Validation

List relevant checks/builds and observed results. Link detailed QA evidence and distinguish automated checks, controlled emulator tests and natural gameplay. Record any outstanding work in the development handoff.
